citations.text: White, J. G., Southgate, E., Thomson, J. N., Brenner, S. (1986). The Structure of the Nervous System of the Nematode Caenorhabditis elegans. Phil. Trans. R. Soc. Lond. B 314, 1-340.

description: Directed weighted multigraph of chemical synapses in the adult hermaphrodite C. elegans with synapse type annotations (Sp, S, R, Rp). Each (pre, post, type) triple is a separate weighted edge. Multiple synapse types between same neuron pair create multi-edges. No autapses. Data from White et al. 1986 via WormAtlas.
name: C. elegans Hermaphrodite Chemical Connectome (Typed)
